title: BREAKING: Next Wave of AI Revolution Confirmed (How we are investing!)
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Professor G hosts Brian for a community-Q&A episode on his channel ('Investing Simplified') covering selling rules, AI investing, ETFs, portfolio construction and stock ideas each. Brian's core selling framework: no price targets (would have clipped Palantir's upside), rebalance so no holding exceeds ~10%, invest asymmetrically (mega-cap core, tiny speculative slivers), and pull principal out of speculative winners after 100-300% gains; he sold Rivian as dead money after 2 years - the afternoon before VW's investment sent it up 30-40% ('you never know what you don't know'; a historical anecdote, not a current call). For AI over 5 years he says it's 'always priced into the next five years' - never fully baked - so dollar-cost average, don't chase: break AI into buckets (compute, hyperscalers, infrastructure/utilities). His three core AI ETFs: SMH (semiconductors, 'treated me like gold'), NUKZ (nuclear - the AI energy choke point), QQQM ('no-brainer'). His stock ideas: Applied Digital ('no-brainer', data-center money machine but priced high - DCA in and buy the inevitable earnings-miss drop) and Ambarella (watch-list edge-computing SoC play for robotics; not yet profitable; once it flips positive 'they explode'). Brian's $10K portfolio: 65% mega caps (AMZN, MSFT, GOOGL, META), 10-15% cash, 5% crypto, 15% asymmetric. Nolan's answers (host-only): 90% three-fund portfolio + 5% Bitcoin + 5% cash; AIQ and ARKQ ETFs; Berkshire Hathaway and IREN. Calls: SMH, NUKZ, QQQM, ARKQ, APLD BUY; AMBA CONDITIONAL_BUY (Brian). Note: 'nukes nukz' = NUKZ; 'Amberella' = Ambarella; 'Pterodine' unresolvable.
